title: Thirdway arrow link
description: A medium-weight link with a hairline underline and a small round arrow chip. On hover the underline draws away and the arrow swaps for a second one sliding in from the left (0.4s expo-out).
notes: follows the colour scope: ink chip on cream, cream chip inside a `dark` block
name: thirdway-arrow-link
